# Split toning

Tints the shadows with one color and the highlights with another, keeping brightness, like a darkroom split tone or a modern teal-and-orange grade.

<EffectDemo effect="split-toning" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { splitToning } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/split-toning';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(splitToning({ preset: 'tealOrange' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.shadows = '#1f6f8b'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type      | Default     | Range  | Description                                                        |
| ------------ | --------- | ----------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `shadows`    | hex color | `'#1f6f8b'` |        | Tint for the shadows.                                              |
| `highlights` | hex color | `'#f2a65a'` |        | Tint for the highlights.                                           |
| `balance`    | number    | `0`         | -1 – 1 | Moves the split: positive gives the shadow tint more of the image. |
| `amount`     | number    | `0.5`       | 0 – 1  | Strength of the toning.                                            |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset          | Settings                                                      |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tealOrange`    | `amount: 0.6`                                                 |
| `sepiaSelenium` | `shadows: '#40506b'`, `highlights: '#c8a46e'`, `amount: 0.6`  |
| `cyberpunk`     | `shadows: '#2a1b6e'`, `highlights: '#ff4fa3'`, `amount: 0.55` |
| `sunset`        | `shadows: '#6b2d5c'`, `highlights: '#ffc15e'`, `balance: 0.2` |

Apply one with `splitToning({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.14 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 0.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/split-toning`, including the shared effect runtime.
